en.titre:
THINGS EVERY MAN
SHOULD DO
BEFORE 30.

en.texte: Cheap, healthy and impressive. Five meals you can make without a recipe.
Save a few months of expenses. Money stress drops when you have a cushion.
A real goal keeps you training. A running coach app like Atala builds your weeks around the race.
One trip on your own teaches you more about yourself than a year at home.
Write a few lines every night. Later, you'll see how far you've come.
